newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power firms as gas rebounds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mid-Atlantic spot power firms as gas rebounds.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool rose Tuesday as natural gas prices rebounded on a short-covering rally and outlook of colder weather in the eastern U.S.
"When gas moved up, it rallied up," said a East Coast broker.

After Monday's plunge, NYMEX January Henry Hub natgas futures climbed 9.9 cents to $3.345 per million British thermal units in midday trading. Cash gas prices in the U.S. Gulf fell, but were still at premium to futures values.
Slightly colder-than-expected weather today pushed peak-hour dispatch rates in PJM higher, said market sources.
"It's a little colder this morning. Dispatch rates for peak hours were higher," a PJM marketer said.
Firm, peak PJM electricity for Wednesday was quoted at $24.50-$25.00 a megawatt hour (MWh) with most deals heard done in the $24.50-$24.75 range.
Today's quote was much lower than Monday's notational $23.50-$25.00 for Tuesday delivery.
Firm, off-peak PJM electricity was notationally assessed at $14.00-$15.50, compared with Monday's $13.00-$15.00 for Tuesday delivery.
PJM power deliveries for the balance of December were valued at $26.75-$27.25 after opening near $26.50. Today's quote fell from Monday's $24.25-$26.00.
January/February 1997 PJM electricity was pegged at $32.25-$32.65 after opening near $32.00. The quote compared with Monday's $32.50-$32.70.
March 1997 PJM deliveries were talked at $25.60-$25.80, a tad higher than $25.40-$25.70 Monday.
Second-quarter 1997 PJM deliveries again held steady at $22.80-$22.90.
July/August 1997 PJM power remained at $32.00-$32.35. Third-quarter 1997 PJM was thinly talked at $28.30-$28.60.
Fourth-quarter 1997 PJM electricity was quoted at $23.50-$23.80, a wider range than Monday's $23.70-$23.80.

Calendar 1997 PJM deliveries during peak hours were discussed at $26.40-$26.50, a narrower range than Monday's $26.35-$26.70. Calendar 1997 off-peak deliveries were valued at $20.90-$21.20, up slightly from $20.80-$21.15 Monday.
The 833 Beaver Valley 2 nuclear power plant was planned to be placed on line today, and resumed full output as early as Wednesday following a refueling and maintenance outage.

For Wednesday, most of the Mid-Atlantic U.S. was forecast to receive peak temperatures in 40s Fahrenheit and off-peak temperatures in the 30s. Extended forecasts showed the region would experience colder-than-seasonal weather next week.
